name: skills
description: Portable skills for engineering refactors, security and supply-chain hardening, tests and CI, accessible UI systems, platform and data migrations, documentation, releases, personal interviews, and clear communication.

interface.longDescription: Review code with evidence, audit database schemas and queries, audit code and repository security, assess SOC 2 readiness with reports in chat, remove unnecessary complexity, refactor with current official docs and regression tests, upgrade minor and major dependencies with migrations and verification, audit dependency freshness and stale overrides, find queries that slow down as data grows, investigate bugs read-only, build issues in meaningful commits with draft PRs, self-review and fix in a loop, sync branches, write commit messages, PR descriptions, and issues, audit merged branches and archivable specs, create new skills, update installed skills and report new or removed ones, reuse your main Chrome session, and communicate clearly at the requested level of detail. Set up signed public GitHub releases with automatic updates and separate development apps, or private releases with licensed updates and device administration. Fix Vercel production and www redirects, reconcile DNS, and verify websites. Report worktrees, Docker resources, extra test databases, and agent-created artifacts directly in chat, reclaim only confirmed items while highlighting protected resources, save Omarchy window layouts, and update existing AI tools and JavaScript runtimes by default with OS-aware verification and a complete status report, skipping missing tools unless installation is explicitly requested and confirmed. Consolidate auth, state, SDKs, routing, errors, and workspaces; harden tests, TypeScript, npm supply chains, and CI; standardize design systems and component libraries; verify accessibility, performance, localization, and platform parity; generate documentation, architecture maps, and searchable single-file HTML wikis; and conduct personal interviews with authorized memory persistence. List every Antick skill by area with its installed status, or find the one that fits a task. Review skills and agent instructions for conflicts, redundant approval gates, and incomplete execution; propose edits while preserving explicit approval boundaries. Build secure Electron apps with native desktop interactions, deliberate text selection, and packaged-runtime verification. Audit home-folder clutter with private metadata snapshots and automatic comparison against the previous run; keep cleanup separately confirmed.
capabilities: Pull request reviews and branch sync
Commit messages, PR descriptions, and issues
defaultPrompt: Review these changes with the code-review skill.
Use $skill-review to review my skills and AGENTS.md files for conflicting instructions and unnecessary confirmation gates. Propose edits before changing files.
Assess this project with the soc2-readiness skill and report findings in chat.
Implement this with the code-build skill.
Refactor this code with current official docs and regression tests using the code-refactor skill.
Audit this repository and its GitHub Actions with the code-security skill.
Review schemas, queries, and migrations with the database-audit skill.
Apply safe patch and minor updates with the dependency-upgrade-minor skill.
Upgrade major versions with migrations using the dependency-upgrade-major skill.
Investigate this bug without changing code using the code-debug skill.
Build these issues, self-review each PR, and fix until clean with the build-review-loop skill.
Explain this with the make-sense skill.
Write explanations, instructions, and reports with the simplify skill.
Set up private desktop distribution with the private-desktop-release skill.
Set up and publish this app with the public-desktop-release skill.
Fix production redirects and DNS warnings with the vercel-domain-cleanup skill.
Report dev-space cleanup candidates and protected resources in chat with reclaim-dev-space, then wait for my confirmation.
Use $home-folder-audit to audit my home-folder clutter, explain dot folders, compare with the previous run, and report cleanup choices without deleting anything.
Save my Omarchy window layout with the save-omarchy-window-layout skill.
Update existing AI tools and report missing tools as skipped with the ai-tools-update skill.
Use $test-suite-hardening. Harden this test suite against flakes, weak assertions, and missing critical behavior coverage.
Use $ci-cd-triage. Diagnose this failing pipeline, fix the root cause, and distinguish local verification from hosted results.
Use $accessibility-audit. Audit and fix accessibility barriers in the main user journeys; report manual and automated coverage separately.
Use $documentation-generation. Generate accurate project documentation from the code and verify safe setup commands, examples, and links.
Use $interview. Interview me in depth about relevant parts of my life you do not know yet, and save useful answers through the supported memory system.
Use $code-refactor to consolidate auth, state, SDKs, routing, and errors with regression protection.
Use $code-build to standardize components and design tokens or wire localization.
Use $code-security to remediate confirmed vulnerabilities and harden dependency installation.
Use $documentation-generation to map this architecture and write an onboarding guide.
Use $update-skills to update my installed skills and list new and removed ones.
Use $antick to list every Antick skill by area and show which are installed.
Use $deep-wiki-html to automatically create or update this repository's HTML wiki and open the result with a clickable viewing link.
Use $electron-app to build an Electron app with native desktop behavior and secure process boundaries.
